name: Takayanagi Kuzuha
source:
Kuzuha is the youngest shrine maiden of a temple located within walking distance of the academy where Kazuya teaches. While she is not enrolled in the institution, her rather unusual nature causes him to have repeated encounters with her. In some ways, Kuzuha is unhappy with her duties.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
